project: Adobe AI Generations Release Security Hardening
purpose: Canonical remediation plan for the Windows installer trust, signing, provenance, AV-heuristic and release-lane issues verified in Adobe_AI_Generations-04. This plan governs distribution hardening; live repository state and built artifacts remain higher authority.
authority_rule: Adobe_AI_Generations-04 source, tagged release workflows, built artifacts, signatures, hashes, runtime/install tests and external scan evidence outrank this projection.

plan_truth.next_single_question: Which Windows code-signing identity/provider will be used for Authenticode signing in CI?

nodes.title: Preserve customer / VirusTotal evidence
nodes.summary: Customer reported heavy VirusTotal behavioral flags. Treat as valid release feedback; do not dismiss as a simple false positive without exact artifact/hash/report evidence.

nodes.title: v2.3.52 installer baseline
nodes.summary: Latest verified tag remains affected: Windows Electron signing discovery is disabled, signing failure is tolerated, final Inno EXE has no proven Authenticode signing gate, and hidden PowerShell UAC relaunch remains present.

nodes.title: Define Authenticode signing architecture
nodes.summary: Choose and configure a trusted Windows code-signing identity/provider. Remove the current signing bypass contract and make signing mandatory for every executable shipped.

nodes.title: Sign inner Electron executable
nodes.summary: The packaged Electron runtime must be Authenticode-signed before it is embedded into the Inno wrapper. Signing failure must fail the build.

nodes.title: Sign final Inno installer
nodes.summary: Sign the final Letterblack-GenAI-Windows-vX.Y.Z.exe after Inno compilation with timestamping and a trusted Windows certificate.

nodes.title: Fail-closed signature verification gates
nodes.summary: CI must verify both inner Electron and final installer signatures using Windows-native Authenticode verification. Missing, invalid, expired-untrusted or wrong-publisher signatures block release.

nodes.title: Remove hidden PowerShell elevation path
nodes.summary: Replace hidden powershell.exe + Start-Process -Verb RunAs self-elevation where possible with a conventional installer/elevation mechanism. If retained, document and test necessity explicitly.

nodes.title: Audit suspicious installer behaviors
nodes.summary: Review process enumeration, elevation, temp/staging writes, stale-copy removal, executable launch, filesystem replacement and any shell invocation. Keep only required behaviors and classify each one.

nodes.title: Prove no process-injection implementation
nodes.summary: Add static/search and behavioral evidence showing the installer does not implement classic remote-process injection. Do not equate CEP evalScript with OS process injection.

nodes.title: Change release pattern
nodes.summary: Development → hardened installer changes → full validation → PR main → pre-tag gate → tag → release workflow → signature/hash/provenance validation → AV/reputation review → distribution. No Gumroad upload before the release evidence gate passes.

nodes.title: Correct signing-secret contract
nodes.summary: Current workflow requires CSC_LINK/CSC_KEY_PASSWORD while Windows packaging disables signing discovery. Secrets and actual artifact signing must be made consistent and independently verified.

nodes.title: Artifact provenance and hash chain
nodes.summary: Generate SHA-256 for Windows EXE, DMG, ZXP and canonical ZIP; bind them to source tag/commit and publish checksums. Compare the exact Gumroad artifact hash with the release artifact before distribution.

nodes.title: Preserve macOS and ZXP trust contracts
nodes.summary: Retain Developer ID signing, hardened runtime, notarization/stapling checks and ZXP signature proof while changing the Windows lane. Do not weaken existing Mac/ZXP gates.

nodes.title: Clean-machine install/uninstall smoke
nodes.summary: Test Windows installer on clean supported Windows hosts: signature trust, SmartScreen experience, user-scope install, elevation fallback, AE detection, CEP/ScriptUI install, upgrade/downgrade behavior and cleanup.

nodes.title: AV / reputation review
nodes.summary: After the final signed artifact is built, review Microsoft Defender/SmartScreen and VirusTotal detections. Investigate behavioral detections individually; do not set an arbitrary zero-detection requirement.

nodes.title: Publish security/distribution release
nodes.summary: Publish only after Windows signatures, provenance, install smoke, existing macOS/ZXP gates and AV review pass. Replace affected Gumroad package and publish updated checksums/release notes.
